reason: I already fill my events and promos through Instagram and WhatsApp for free, and I check my own totals every night. Putting public per-dish ratings on my small café feels like handing my reputation to strangers for 59 GEL a month plus extra card fees.
objection: One bad rating on a dish stays public forever and I can't answer it or take it down. On top of that, the payment partner's fee comes out of my already thin margin.
would_change_my_mind: If I could keep dish ratings private, so only I see them, and still get the loyalty and guest messaging, I'd try the free 3 months.
